text:
ana: Customer asked for an operational Console feature: tie route-level cost deltas to error/latency incidents and export a compact incident artifact for finance. Quick sketch + asks below.
mike: Nice. We should define exact GA gates and a light canary.
sasha: Storage constraint: we can't store raw traces forever. Default sampling + forced-on for errors/anomalies. Compression + dedupe required.
praveen: Implementation note: pre-sample, emit a tiny protobuf envelope async, batch uploads. Keep dataplane overhead <10% CPU.
joan: Product must include RBAC for billing vs engineering, export CSV for finance, and PII redaction + KMS tagging for Private installs. These are GA blockers.
nana: (typo  ana) MVP surface: route token meter (top-N), per-model cost multiplier, sampled trace links in incident card, one dashboard template, RBAC + export + redaction toggle.
mike: Canary plan: 5% tenants x 48h -> 25% x 72h -> GA. Monitor p50/p95, per-route cost-per-1k, error-rate. Abort on p95 regression >5% or error uplift >0.25pp or infra spend >18% in canary.
sasha: Default retention proposal: sampled full traces 14d, sampled excerpts 30d, aggregates 90d. Default sampling 0.05% global with route overrides.
praveen: Example sampling config we expose:
  sampling.default=0.0005
  sampling.routes./v1/generate=0.005
  sampling.rules.on_error=1.0
  sampling.rules.on_anomaly=1.0
Include sampling_rate in exports so finance knows confidence.
mike: Incident artifact idea: tenant, time window, top routes, cost_delta_est, tokens_delta, model_variant, sample_trace_ids, sampling_rate, confidence(low|med|high). Small and exportable.
joan: Acceptance (draft): functional: incident artifact + route cost visible; perf: dataplane overhead <10%; economics: telemetry delta target <+12% infra spend first quarter, hard guardrail +25%; security: redaction + KMS tagging; UX: incident card + CSV export.
sasha: Engineering ask: we need expected event sizes & QPS to simulate and tune retention knobs. Product to supply customer vignette.
praveen: Perf detail: apply per-route pre-sampling, write envelope to WAL, async indexer to avoid request latency. Use per-tenant batching to lower object counts.
mike: I'll mock the canary dashboard and alerts. Will add temporary view showing route -> cost, latency, errors, sampling.
devops-bot: created issue #5211 "console: route-cost incident export + sampled traces" and assigned to @ana @mike @sasha. https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/5211
joan: Priority: top-10 customer ask; recommend P0 next quarter. Next steps: Mike dash proto (Tue), Praveen proto + perf sims (Wed), Sasha storage calc + knobs (Fri), Joan RBAC + vignette (5d). Booking a 30m follow-up after artifacts land. Thanks :thumbsup:
